papers.title_zh: MSSP：用于 3D 点云无监督语义分割的多尺度空间约束分区
papers.summary_zh: 3D 点云语义分割对于现实世界的空间理解至关重要，但人工注释的高昂成本催生了不需要标签的无监督方法。现有的基于超点的方法通常依赖于固定粒度的频谱分析，无法捕获复杂室内场景中固有的分层语义结构。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个多尺度空间约束分区（MSSP）框架，它将多尺度谱分析与空间约束聚类相结合。多尺度谱分析构建跨多个聚类粒度的丰富的超点描述符；然而，由此产生的高维特征空间需要先进行结构转换才能转换为更清晰的分割。空间约束聚类通过将超点合并限制到物理相邻区域来提供此先验，从而强加多尺度特征有效所需的空间一致性。在 S3DIS 和 ScanNet 上进行的大量实验表明，MSSP 在主要基准测试中实现了无监督方法中最好的 mIoU，在 S3DIS 上的收益尤其显着。值得注意的是，我们的消融揭示了正则化然后丰富的相互作用：多尺度特征本身并不能改善最终分割，但在与空间正则化结合时变得非常有效，强调空间一致性是超点聚类中多尺度表示的先决条件。

papers.title: Large Classification-Risk-Optional Label Acquisition
papers.summary: We study how a limited labeling budget should be allocated to minimize multiclass zero-one classification risk. We consider parametric classification problems in which features are observed for all sampling units while class labels can be acquired selectively. By combining the Fisher information supplied by an acquired label with the local geometry of multiclass excess risk, we derive an acquisition criterion that minimizes the leading asymptotic coefficient of expected multiclass excess risk. The resulting rule values a label according to how strongly its information is aligned with parameter directions that perturb the active Bayes decision boundary, rather than according to posterior uncertainty or global parameter information alone. We characterize the oracle acquisition design, establish its threshold structure, and derive face-specific and cost-sensitive extensions. An analytic example shows that posterior uncertainty and classification value can produce different, and even reversed, acquisition rankings. We further develop a two-stage adaptive procedure that attains the oracle leading-risk criterion under regularity conditions and provide explicit results for Gaussian discriminant analysis. Three-class QDA experiments illustrate the resulting acquisition geometry, while an application to the six-class Statlog Landsat Satellite data shows that classification-risk acquisition can differ materially from both uncertainty-based acquisition and the complete-classification-information comparator. The adaptive classification-risk design attains lower mean error than this Fisher comparator across the labeling budgets considered, although it does not uniformly outperform entropy or margin sampling and differences among the targeted strategies become small as the labeling budget increases.
papers.title_zh: 大分类-风险-可选标签获取
papers.summary_zh: 我们研究如何分配有限的标签预算以最小化多类零一分类风险。我们考虑参数分类问题，其中观察所有采样单元的特征，同时可以有选择地获取类别标签。通过将获取的标签提供的 Fisher 信息与多类超额风险的局部几何结构相结合，我们得出了一个获取标准，该标准可最小化预期多类超额风险的领先渐近系数。生成的规则根据其信息与扰乱主动贝叶斯决策边界的参数方向的对齐程度来评估标签，而不是仅根据后验不确定性或全局参数信息。我们描述了预言机获取设计的特征，建立了其阈值结构，并导出了特定于人脸且成本敏感的扩展。一个分析示例表明，后验不确定性和分类值可以产生不同的甚至相反的获取排名。我们进一步开发了一个两阶段自适应程序，该程序在规律性条件下达到预言机领先风险标准，并为高斯判别分析提供明确的结果。三类 QDA 实验说明了所得的采集几何结构，而对六类 Statlog Landsat 卫星数据的应用表明，分类风险采集可能与基于不确定性的采集和完整分类信息比较器存在重大差异。自适应分类风险设计在所考虑的标签预算中获得了比费舍尔比较器更低的平均误差，尽管它并不完全优于熵或边际采样，并且随着标签预算的增加，目标策略之间的差异变小。

papers.title: Drones as Annotators: Amodal 3D Auto-Labeling for Ground LiDAR with Aerial Priors
papers.summary: Scaling perception data in autonomous driving is hindered by manual 3D bounding box annotation, a costly and labor intensive process requiring substantial domain expertise. Existing auto-labeling methods reduce this burden, but most of them rely on onboard sensors, where a single ground-level viewpoint yields occluded and sparse observations and inaccurate object geometry. We introduce DAA (Drones as Annotators), a drone-assisted training-free framework for amodal 3D auto-labeling. DAA augments ground LiDAR with an aerial agent that provides less occluded vehicle detections with continuous tracks. Ground LiDAR, in turn, provides precise metric 3D geometry unavailable from aerial imagery alone. DAA exploits the two complementary yet heterogeneous modalities through a two-stage framework: (i) air-ground coordinate alignment unifies aerial detections and ground LiDAR scans into a shared map frame and bootstraps coarse 3D bounding boxes from the aligned aerial detections; (ii) EM-like amodal box refinement alternates between identifying the vehicle's foreground points and updating the coarse box from the identified foreground and aerial priors. We evaluate DAA on an air-ground cooperative perception dataset, where it consistently outperforms existing auto-labeling baselines. LiDAR detectors trained on DAA-generated labels remain competitive with those trained on manual annotations at moderate IoU thresholds. Evaluation against a reference vehicle with known poses and dimensions further confirms its accuracy. We also demonstrate that DAA transfers, without parameter retuning, from onboard to stationary roadside LiDAR and to multi-agent fused point clouds. Code and dataset will be released upon publication.
papers.title_zh: 无人机作为注释器：采用空中先验的地面 LiDAR 的 Amodal 3D 自动标记
papers.summary_zh: 自动驾驶中感知数据的缩放受到手动 3D 边界框注释的阻碍，这是一个成本高昂且劳动密集型的过程，需要大量的领域专业知识。现有的自动标记方法减轻了这种负担，但大多数都依赖于机载传感器，其中单个地面视点会产生遮挡和稀疏的观察结果以及不准确的物体几何形状。我们介绍 DAA（无人机作为注释器），这是一种无人机辅助的免训练框架，用于非模态 3D 自动标记。 DAA 通过空中代理增强地面 LiDAR，通过连续轨迹提供较少遮挡的车辆检测。反过来，地面 LiDAR 可以提供仅通过航空图像无法获得的精确公制 3D 几何形状。 DAA 通过两阶段框架利用两种互补但异构的模式：(i) 空地坐标对齐将空中探测和地面 LiDAR 扫描统一到共享地图框架中，并从对齐的空中探测中引导粗略的 3D 边界框； (ii) 类似 EM 的非模态框细化在识别车辆的前景点和根据识别的前景和空中先验更新粗框之间交替。我们在空地协同感知数据集上评估 DAA，它的性能始终优于现有的自动标记基线。在 DAA 生成的标签上训练的 LiDAR 探测器与在中等 IoU 阈值下进行手动注释训练的 LiDAR 探测器仍然具有竞争力。针对具有已知姿态和尺寸的参考车辆的评估进一步证实了其准确性。我们还演示了 DAA 在不重新调整参数的情况下从车载激光雷达转移到固定路边激光雷达以及多智能体融合点云。代码和数据集将在发布后发布。

papers.title: Monte Carlo-Based Ex-Ante Assessment of the Green Benefits of an AI-Driven Smart Agriculture Platform in Hainan
papers.summary: Smart agriculture platforms are widely regarded as key carriers for implementing China's pesticide and fertilizer reduction, water-saving and carbon-reduction agendas, yet a unified quantitative framework for assessing their green value is still lacking. Taking an AI-driven decision platform for tropical agriculture as the object (integrating large-language-model question answering, multimodal pest diagnosis, IoT sensing, satellite remote sensing, and a closed-loop field record system), this study builds a cradle-to-farm-gate agricultural carbon accounting model covering pesticide and fertilizer production, field N2O, irrigation electricity and paddy CH4, translates platform interventions into quantifiable transmission parameters, and propagates parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo simulation over three Hainan scenarios (mango, winter vegetable, rice/nanfan, area-weighted 40%:30%:30%). Under full adoption, median reductions are 23.5% (90% interval 15.0%-33.2%) for pesticide use, 21.0% (13.8%-28.9%) for fertilizer, 16.5% (10.9%-23.5%) for irrigation water, and 21.5% (16.1%-27.2%) for carbon intensity. Attainment probabilities are high for fertilizer reduction >=15% (90.6%) and clear carbon decline (98.1%), but only about 20% for aggregate water saving >=20%, favoring scenario-specific statements. Sobol first-order indices show soil-test recommendation and organic substitution jointly explain about 83% of the variance of aggregate carbon-intensity reduction. Convergence tests show 10,000 iterations stabilize all statistics; conservative/baseline/optimistic scenario bounds are reported. The framework offers a reproducible, calibration-ready methodology for ex-ante green-value assessment and pilot observation design.

papers.title_zh: 基于蒙特卡罗的海南人工智能驱动智慧农业平台绿色效益事前评估
papers.summary_zh: 智慧农业平台被广泛认为是实施中国减农药、减化肥、节水减碳议程的关键载体，但仍缺乏统一的绿色价值评估量化框架。本研究以人工智能驱动的热带农业决策平台为对象（集成大语言模型问答、多模态害虫诊断、物联网传感、卫星遥感和闭环田间记录系统），构建涵盖农药和化肥生产、田间N2O、灌溉电力和水稻CH4的从摇篮到农场的农业碳核算模型，将平台干预转化为可量化的传输参数，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟在海南三种情景（芒果、冬季）中传播参数不确定性。蔬菜、大米/南番，面积加权40%:30%:30%）。在全面采用的情况下，农药使用量中位数减少 23.5%（90%区间 15.0%-33.2%），化肥使用量减少 21.0%（13.8%-28.9%），灌溉用水减少 16.5%（10.9%-23.5%），碳强度减少 21.5%（16.1%-27.2%）。化肥减少 >=15% (90.6%) 和碳明显减少 (98.1%) 的实现概率很高，但总节水 >=20% 的实现概率仅为 20% 左右，有利于特定场景的陈述。索博尔一阶指数显示土壤测试建议和有机替代共同解释了总碳强度降低的约 83% 的方差。收敛测试显示 10,000 次迭代稳定了所有统计数据；报告保守/基线/乐观情景界限。该框架为事前绿色价值评估和试点观测设计提供了可重复、可校准的方法。

papers.title: Likelihood-Based Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in CMS Dijet Events
papers.summary: We present an unsupervised search for anomalous dijet events in proton--proton collision data using neural spline flow density estimation. A normalizing flow model is trained on a high-dimensional feature space comprising jet, dijet, and event-level observables to learn the dominant Standard Model background directly from data, without assuming a specific signal hypothesis. Events assigned low likelihood under the learned density are identified as potential anomalous events. Using this approach on a CMS Open Data dijet sample, we investigate extreme events in the tail of the anomaly-score distribution and perform an extensive validation and robustness study. This study includes feature-level statistical comparisons, mass decorrelation tests, permutation-based null tests, and evaluations of training stability. The selected anomalous events exhibit notable departures from the background-only expectation, primarily in jet-substructure observables, while remaining stable under several known sources of bias in unsupervised learning. The identified anomalies are distributed across the kinematic phase space and do not exhibit a narrow structure in the dijet invariant-mass spectrum. Instead, they show correlated deviations across multiple observables, consistent with a multivariate difference in jet substructure and event topology rather than a localized resonance. While no claim of new physics is made, this study demonstrates that neural spline flow-based density estimation can be sensitive to rare, structured deviations in collider data and may provide a model-independent exploratory tool for searches for physics beyond the Standard Model at the LHC.
papers.title_zh: CMS Dijet 事件中基于可能性的无监督异常检测
papers.summary_zh: 我们使用神经样条流密度估计对质子-质子碰撞数据中的异常双射事件进行无监督搜索。归一化流模型在包含 jet、dijet 和事件级可观测值的高维特征空间上进行训练，以直接从数据中学习主要的标准模型背景，而无需假设特定的信号假设。在学习密度下被分配低可能性的事件被识别为潜在的异常事件。在 CMS 开放数据 dijet 样本上使用这种方法，我们调查了异常分数分布尾部的极端事件，并进行了广泛的验证和稳健性研究。这项研究包括特征级统计比较、质量去相关测试、基于排列的零测试以及训练稳定性评估。选定的异常事件与仅背景预期显着背离，主要是在喷射子结构可观测值中，同时在无监督学习中的几个已知偏差来源下保持稳定。所识别的异常分布在整个运动相空间中，并且在双喷射不变质谱中没有表现出狭窄的结构。相反，它们显示了多个可观测值的相关偏差，与喷流子结构和事件拓扑的多元差异一致，而不是局部共振。虽然没有提出新物理学的主张，但这项研究表明，基于神经样条流的密度估计可以对对撞机数据中罕见的结构化偏差敏感，并且可以提供一种独立于模型的探索工具，用于搜索大型强子对撞机标准模型之外的物理学。
